Name: Incursion
Overview: In Incursion you control immigrants from all over the world. Use resources to train four types of immigrants: the digger, the snipper, the sprinter, and the mine sweeper. You will face treacherous terrain, rivers, barbed-wire fences, border guards, and even landmines! Players will glimpse what so many people all over the world strive for, a chance to start a better life in a new country.
